name: Chicken Spinach Egg Casserole
ingredients: 1.25 lb boneless skinless chicken breast, diced small
instructions: Heat the oven to 375°F. Oil a baking dish.
Stir the chicken, eggs, spinach, pepper, and garlic powder.
Bake 30–35 minutes, until the center is set and the chicken is 165°F.
Rest 10 minutes. Cut into 4 boxes.
doneWhen: The center is set, the protein is cooked through, and the pan cuts into 4 even boxes.
tips: An oven casserole, not a slow cooker. Fridge 3 days. No cheese in this one.

name: Beef and Egg Casserole
instructions: Heat the oven to 375°F.
Brown the beef with pepper, garlic powder, and paprika. Drain the fat.
Stir in the eggs and spread in a baking dish.
Bake 30–35 minutes, until the eggs are set and no pink beef remains.
Rest 10 minutes. Cut into 4 boxes.
doneWhen: The center is set, the protein is cooked through, and the pan cuts into 4 even boxes.
tips: Drain the beef or the casserole weeps. Fridge 3 days.

name: Turkey Pepper Egg Casserole
instructions: Heat the oven to 375°F.
Brown the turkey with paprika, pepper, and garlic powder.
Stir in the eggs and bell pepper. Spread in a baking dish.
Bake 30–35 minutes, to 165°F.
Rest 10 minutes. Cut into 4 boxes.
doneWhen: The center is set, the protein is cooked through, and the pan cuts into 4 even boxes.
tips: Breast meat, not a salty sausage blend. Fridge 3 days.

name: Chicken and Broccoli Casserole
ingredients: 1.5 lb boneless skinless chicken breast, diced
instructions: Heat the oven to 375°F. Oil a baking dish.
Toss the chicken and broccoli with yogurt, pepper, and garlic powder.
Spread in the dish and top with the cheddar.
Bake about 30 minutes, until the chicken is 165°F and the broccoli is tender.
Cut into 4 boxes.
doneWhen: The center is set, the protein is cooked through, and the pan cuts into 4 even boxes.
tips: Two ounces of cheddar for the whole pan, not a soup-mix crust. Fridge 4 days.

name: Tuna Egg Casserole
instructions: Heat the oven to 375°F.
Stir the tuna, eggs, cottage cheese, spinach, pepper, and dill.
Bake about 30 minutes, until the center is set.
Rest 10 minutes. Cut into 4 boxes.
doneWhen: The center is set, the protein is cooked through, and the pan cuts into 4 even boxes.
tips: No noodles. Both the tuna and the cottage cheese have to say no salt added. Fridge 3 days.

name: Beef and Cauliflower Casserole
instructions: Heat the oven to 375°F.
Brown the beef with pepper, garlic powder, and paprika. Drain the fat.
Steam the cauliflower until just tender, about 6 minutes.
Stir the beef and cauliflower together in a baking dish. Top with the cheddar.
Bake about 20 minutes, until the cheese melts and the beef is hot.
Cut into 4 boxes.
doneWhen: The center is set, the protein is cooked through, and the pan cuts into 4 even boxes.
tips: Cauliflower instead of potatoes. Two ounces of cheese for the pan. Fridge 4 days.

name: Pork and Cabbage Casserole
instructions: Heat the oven to 375°F.
Toss the pork and cabbage with butter, pepper, garlic powder, and paprika.
Spread in a baking dish. Cover for the first 20 minutes.
Uncover and bake until the pork is 145°F and the cabbage is soft, about 15 minutes more.
Rest 5 minutes. Divide into 4 boxes.
doneWhen: The center is set, the protein is cooked through, and the pan cuts into 4 even boxes.
tips: No cheese and no applesauce. Tenderloin, not sausage. Fridge 4 days.

name: Salmon Spinach Egg Casserole
ingredients: 1.25 lb salmon, skin off, in chunks
instructions: Heat the oven to 375°F. Oil a baking dish.
Fold the salmon, eggs, spinach, pepper, and dill together.
Bake 25–30 minutes, until the eggs are set and the salmon flakes.
Rest 5 minutes. Cut into 4 boxes.
doneWhen: The center is set, the protein is cooked through, and the pan cuts into 4 even boxes.
tips: Check at 25 minutes. Salmon dries out if the eggs go too long. Fridge 2 days.
